Lena (Growth): Quick thread: rolling a compact launch newsletter + 3-email nurture to support the benchmark blog and webinar. need subject, segments, canary plan.
Priya Rao: i created 3 subject angles: outcome, technical, and curiosity. my pick: outcome for dev leads.
Yuki (Design): pared hero to one line for mobile. keeping CTA above-the-fold.
Marco (Events): webinar invite should be a separate follow-up to engaged cohorts only. consider .ics attach for trials.
Owen (Deliverability): heads-up 10% uptick in soft bounces for corp domains last week. recommend seeded canary + suppression sweep.
Lena (Growth): segmentation proposal:
- S1: high-intent (trial activity last 14d)
- S2: integrations leads (signup form + interest in integrations)
- S3: general newsletter / rewarm
Lena (Growth): subject options (A/B/C):
A) Benchmark: real latency wins + token savings
B) Save on inference cost 10minute read
C) How teams cut token cost 3x (short)
Priya Rao: pairing: B with preview "practical tips for infra teams" for S1.
Yuki (Design): trimming hero to 42 chars to avoid truncation. exported templates to the marketing doc (draft).
Owen (Deliverability): canary headers to include:
X-Redwood-Canary: bench-3274
List-Unsubscribe: <https://redwood.example.com/unsub>
Also enable domain-specific link wrapping TTL for APAC.
Lena (Growth): canary plan: 250 users (80 S1, 80 S2, 90 S3) split across regions Tue 09:00 PT. full send Fri with regional windows (APAC morning, EMEA late morning, NA morning PT).
Nora (Ops): noted. will set throttles (20k/hr) and exponential backoff for 421/451 responses. will schedule canary now.
deploy-bot: canary-send created id=canary-3274500000 users=250 time=2024-08-06T16:00:00Z
Marco (Events): for S1 follow-ups, send webinar invite 48h after if CTR > 12%. include .ics for trials.
Priya Rao: CTA test: primary -> /use-cases, alt -> /try-now. we'll A/B within S1 during canary to see lift in trial starts. add utm=nl_bench_aug.
Owen (Deliverability): i'll run suppression sweep now and post a short canary report within 30m of completion (spam-trap, bounces, deliverability score).
Yuki (Design): i'll run heatmap after canary and adjust CTA placement if needed.
Lena (Growth): success metrics: open rate, CTR to /use-cases, trial starts, bounce rate <0.8%. if canary looks good -> full split. final review Mon EOD.
Nora (Ops): scheduling note: will add a safety pause if any segment bounce >0.7% for 15m.
Lena (Growth): thanks all. locking for now.
